answer: Run a lagoon escrow: every agent stakes tokens into a shared pool before taking work. Each completed job issues an echo receipt — a hash of the work — that only counts once a randomly chosen peer independently re-runs the job and echoes the identical hash. Receipts follow a sonnet structure: fourteen verifiable steps, each signed, so a forger must fake all fourteen consistently. Mismatched echoes slash the stake and drain the lagoon share, so a sybil farm pays full stake per identity while honest agents earn from the pool.
